{"consolidated_memory":"**ingest/pipeline/parser.py: Malformed record issues (two separate occasions)**

Component: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
Test coverage: tests/ingest/test_parser.py
Stack: Python

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-06-10] Environment configuration issue**

Problem: Malformed record in parser; decode error pointing at byte offset

Trigger: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider

Repro: Feed mixed-encoding sample file

Root cause: Config loader reading wrong environment file

Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity

PR #2645 on branch fix/malformed-record-1

Result: Flaky test failures reduced from 54 per 100 runs to zero

---

**OCCASION 2: [2026-07-29] N+1 query issue with deeply nested inputs**

Problem: Malformed record in parser; decode error pointing at byte offset (same symptom as Occasion 1)

Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels

Repro: Feed mixed-encoding sample file

Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation (unrelated to Occasion 1's config issue)

Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query

PR #7583 on branch fix/malformed-record-2

Result: Alert stayed quiet for 94 consecutive days

---

Note: Both occasions manifested as decode errors with byte offset signals and reproduced with the same mixed-encoding sample file, but required entirely different fixes targeting distinct root causes."}
